project_scope: QuranHikma Tafsir only; separate from Global Equb

bounded_target.subclaim: Determine whether NYU/Columbia ACO record columbia_aco001654 maps to vol.20 or printed p.192
bounded_target.action: Checked official ACO records and targeted exact-ID searches; no source-grounded mapping from the general item to the claimed volume/page was established.

source_anchors.source: NYU/Columbia Arabic Collections Online, general Qurtubi catalog record
source_anchors.supports: Qurtubi al-Jamiʿ, Cairo, Dar al-Kutub al-Misriyyah, publication date 1935-; this general record does not establish a volume number or page 192.

source_anchors.locator: Title metadata identifies al-Jamiʿ li-ahkam al-Qurʾan v.19
source_anchors.supports: An official related volume record explicitly labels item 001663 as volume 19; it does not identify item 001654 as volume 20.

source_anchors.locator: Title metadata identifies al-Jamiʿ li-ahkam al-Qurʾan v.17
source_anchors.supports: An official related volume record labels item 001665 as volume 17; item identifiers therefore cannot safely be treated as sequential volume numbers.
The digital presentation labels the Sūrah al-Kawthar opening as part 20, p.192; it does not establish that the NYU/Columbia scan is that same witness.
Electronic page label 602 is distinct from a demonstrated print-page locator.

confirmed: The broad NYU/Columbia catalog record is for a Qurtubi Cairo/Dar al-Kutub witness dated 1935-.
The exact-volume/page mapping remains unresolved; no evidence supports assigning item 001654 to vol.20 or printed p.192.
The targeted result did not justify inferring a volume from nearby numeric item IDs.
not_established: That NYU/Columbia item columbia_aco001654 is vol.20.
That the item contains the Sūrah 108 passage at printed page 192.
That KSU derives from the NYU/Columbia witness.
That live legacy source_url value 671 identifies an edition, volume, or page.
finding.scope_guard: Do not import the separate Medinan-opinion clause naming Mujahid into the stored Arabic opening. Keep any one-name English correction proposal unapplied pending independent scholarly review.

next_bounded_step: Request independent review of the Qurtubi witness pair and, separately, obtain a direct archive image/page mapping or retain edition provenance as unresolved. Do not write to production or relabel source_url 671.
